integrity: A self-contained symbolic proof and standard-library finite checker accompany the formulas; finite tests do not constitute an unrestricted proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact formulas require h>=3, m,d>=1, gcd(m*(h^3-h+1),d)=1 and a=m*(h^3-h+1).
No result for arbitrary a, longer geometric families, or the known binary h=2 case is claimed new.
Prior implicit equivalent results and independent mathematical validation are not excluded.
title: Exact Apéry sets and type two for a nonbinary generalized-Mersenne family
